sentences.en: He knocks the mighty from the throne and elevates the humble.
sentences.zh: 他推翻了强大的人并提升了卑微的人。

sentences.en: An elevated seaside bike path collapsed in Rio.
sentences.zh: 里奥的一条高架海边自行车道倒塌了。

sentences.en: Two persons were killed when an elevated bike path collapsed in Rio.
sentences.zh: 里奥的一条高架自行车道倒塌，造成两人死亡。

senses.zh: 提升，提高；提拔，晋升；使更高尚，使更崇高

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+lev（举起）+ate（使…） →举起
